title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
hook_text: AI agents are getting scammed on purpose.
script:
Apate is deploying AI agents undercover to get scammed on purpose.
While most businesses use AI to speed up workflows, Apate uses them to gather fraud intelligence.
The autonomous agents engage directly with fraudsters to map out malicious financial schemes.
By entering scam pipelines, the software collects real-time data on how modern cybercriminals operate.
This intelligence helps security teams dismantle financial fraud networks before they target more victims.
Would you trust an autonomous agent to infiltrate your own scam calls?
